alias: Den tall lamp off with sideboard lamp
description: Turns the den tall lamp (WiZ) off when the sideboard lamp's plug goes from 1 W or more to 0 W (owner, 2026-10-23). The plug measures whole watts, so turning the sideboard lamp down to its lowest setting (under 1 W) reads 0 W and also turns the tall lamp off. Fires only on that change between two real readings: a reading going to or from unavailable never counts, and there is deliberately no re-check on HA start or reload, so the tall lamp can still be used on its own. Pair: den_tall_lamp_on_with_sideboard_lamp. Source: tools/ha/automations in the HomeAssistant repo.
